decision.question: Should we start ZenithCred investor outreach now with current materials, or wait for MVP/demo?
decision.recommendation: Start now. Send the deck to 3 warm-up targets (Volta, Peak, Keen) as 'early conversations' — not asking for money yet, just gauging interest and getting feedback. This de-risks the May close timeline without requiring a finished MVP.
evidence: ZenithCred deep strategy lists MVP as critical gap — no working prototype exists
Seed timeline was close-by-May, now at risk of slipping to Jul+ with zero investor contact
Pitch deck, financials, competitive analysis, pilot targets (Bynder, Effectory, etc.) all ready
Industry norm: seed investors expect to meet founders 2-3 months before writing checks
An HTML demo (mvp-demo.html) exists in VDR — may be enough for early conversations

options.label: Start outreach now
options.description: Send deck to 3 VCs this week as 'intro/feedback' meetings. Build relationships while MVP develops.

options.label: Wait for MVP
options.description: Build working demo first (4-6 weeks), then outreach. Stronger pitch but May close impossible.

options.label: LOIs first
options.description: Get 2-3 LOIs from pilot targets (Bynder, Effectory) before any investor contact. Strongest signal but slowest path.
